title: A trip that stays in the diary
description: Link the places, photographs and notes you choose, and prepare the story for the people back home or for print.

blocks.text: After a trip, a person wants to keep the story for the people back home or for print. The plan shows intentions, but the visits, photographs and impressions that actually happened may have turned out differently.

quote.text: The photo book created at the end of 4 weeks in Europe was so good we bought it.

blocks.text: The shots and notes chosen are linked to the days and places as they actually were. The draft can be edited, trimmed and turned into a separate version for sending or for a photo book.
What decides whether it is useful

This idea solves a keepsake job, not a logistical one. It is worth testing after a trip is over: does the person want to edit the story they are offered and use the result. An automatic feed of every movement may turn out to be unnecessary.
